project_info.theme: Community celebration photo from the En France Ensemble event
project_info.color_palette: Warm Stage Gold, Charcoal, Soft Skin Tones, Pink, White

main_subject.detail: A wide group photo of a large multi-row crowd of students, parents, and organizers posing indoors with raised hands in front of a brightly lit event stage backdrop reading 'EnFrance Ensemble'.
main_subject.style: Real event photography with wide-angle composition, balanced stage lighting, and candid group energy.

composition_elements.text:
VFE VIETNAM FRANCE EXCHANGE
EnFrance Ensemble
items: Top Left: Small VFE logo in white corner overlay.
Top Right: Large decorative ceiling light installation and stage truss lighting rig.
Bottom Left: Front seated row of attendees in dresses and semi-formal clothing.
Bottom Right: Standing side attendees including a man in a pink polo waving at the edge.
Center/Background: Large crowd spanning the frame, warm stage backdrop with the event title, and conference hall interior.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm ambient illumination, evenly exposed faces across a large group, subtle stage glow, and authentic conference-hall depth.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality event recap group photo for VFE. Centerpiece is a large multi-row crowd posing in front of a warm illuminated stage backdrop reading 'EnFrance Ensemble'. Background is a hotel or conference hall interior with stage truss, ceiling lights, and dark side walls. Surrounding elements: VFE logo overlay at top left, seated front row, standing middle and back rows, and wide indoor event perspective. Technical style: photoreal documentary event photography, indoor event stage lighting, even face exposure, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
